title: Joshua
introduction: Joshua records Israel's crossing of the Jordan, the conquest and division of the promised land, and Joshua's farewell covenant at Shechem. These twelve studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim twelve independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
